description.value: Cascadia Liquor is a Vancouver Island-based liquor retail chain with multiple locations offering a broad selection of wine, beer, spirits, and coolers, with a deliberate focus on BC wines and Vancouver Island craft beers. The Fifth Street Victoria location is part of a community-engaged business that hosts in-store masterclasses and tasting events. Touring cyclists finishing a day on the road will find a well-curated local product selection here.
